messages:
Carmen (AE): FYI Helix Health needs a compact assurance packet for the POC: SOC 2 excerpt (scope + date), ISO 27001 cert screenshot, pen-test attestation (signed), a one-page control mapping to HIPAA ePHI categories, and a short note on Hosted vs Dedicated POC pricing/commit. They want a single ZIP for the contract dataroom. Can we assemble by EOD tomorrow?
Ethan (SE): I can pull the SOC 2 excerpt and draft a 2-paragraph control summary (auth, encryption-at-rest, logging/retention). Will include effective date and auditor name.
Lina (Security): I will draft the pen-test attestation template + an executive summary (date, scope, top findings, remediation status). Also add a brief KMS/keys statement (keys not exported, customer-namespaced KMS) and staging creds note (ephemeral). Need Legal to confirm signer.
Yasmin (Legal): I can sign the attestation as Head of Legal. Please don't include operational guarantees in the attestation text; route any redlines to Legal. Small edits I can review same day, complex redlines may take up to 48h.
Omar (SRE): I will generate a sanitized network/dataflow diagram (no IPs/hostnames) and a hosting manifest (region, tenancy type, storage encryption). For delivery we can either upload to their dataroom or provide a presigned S3 link; prefer dataroom if possible. Example presign (7d): `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/helix-poc-assurance.zip --expires-in 604800`
Ethan (SE): Pricing quick note: Hosted = no reservation, pay-as-you-go (higher under sustained load). Dedicated = short reserved slot (2-week minimum typical) + onboarding/setup fee. I'll make a 1-row cost comparison with low/med/high usage estimations.
Lina (Security): Staging scan policy: authenticated scans allowed in scheduled 3-hour windows with 48h notice and a POC point-of-contact. Will include scheduling alias and escalation. Also include a line in README: raw pentest reports are not shared without NDA and explicit agreement; we provide exec summary + remediation status.
TicketBot: Ticket #POC-18901 created: "Helix POC assurance packet" assigned to Lina, Ethan, Omar. Due: 2026-01-16.
Carmen (AE): Action list: Lina -> attestation + exec summary + staging scan policy; Yasmin -> confirm signer (done); Omar -> sanitized diagram + manifest + presign (if dataroom blocked); Ethan -> SOC 2 excerpt + pricing table. Target ZIP upload by 16:00 PT tomorrow.
Lina (Security): I will post draft attestation in the ticket by 10:00 PT tomorrow and flag any disclosure limits.
Omar (SRE): Diagram + manifest ETA: tomorrow 12:30 PT. I will attach the presign command in the ticket as fallback.
Ethan (SE): SOC 2 excerpt + pricing table ETA: tomorrow 15:00 PT.
Yasmin (Legal): Pre-approving signer text now; will sign final attestation once Lina posts it.
Carmen (AE): Thanks team 44D Ill confirm NDA/dataroom access with Helix and tell them well deliver a single ZIP. Ping me if anything blocks.
